correctness.rationale: Conditional on K=k, change sets have q^{sum positions} weights. The source computes odd/even magnetization masses from Gaussian-binomial run-compositions and derives their pointwise proportionality, plus the likelihood ratio factor (1-q^{2(a-j)})(1-q^{2(m-a-j)}) strictly decreasing in |2a-m|, with a polynomial limit at q=1. The four-spin K=1,2 central masses are v/(u+v+w) and uw/(uv+uw+vw), yielding v^2=uw and overlapping geometric odds. Independent exact Fraction enumeration checks n=2..9 and q=1/2,1,3/2,2. Requires fair first spin and independent strictly positive flip odds.
